SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-04-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-25-2021 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF KATHERINE BIRD IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT JOSH COHEN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT ELLEN EISEN IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT: $1250 (PREVIOUSLY PAID) PLUS COURT COSTS OF $155 TOTALING $1405 WHICH LEAVES A BALANCE PAYMENT OF $155 TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE AUG-25TH HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PRIOR TO THE HEARING, HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG PRESENTED DISCLOSURE, AND LITIGATE(S)DID NOT OBJECT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
